name: seo-geo-god
description: SEO and GEO for coding agents: detect the stack, fix crawlability, rendering, metadata, structured data, sitemaps, hreflang and AI-crawler access in code, and verify with an offline, stdlib-only audit CLI and CI gates.

interface.shortDescription: Fix SEO and AI search in code
interface.longDescription: Skills and agent briefs for search engine optimization (SEO) and generative engine optimization (GEO) work inside a codebase: stack detection, crawl and index controls, rendering, metadata, structured data, sitemaps, hreflang, internal links, media, performance signals, AI-crawler access, agent readiness, fact-preserving citability edits, entity identity, content quality, measurement and CI regression gates. A bundled Python standard-library CLI audits build output, local servers and user-supplied exports offline; live fetching is opt-in. Platform facts are dated 2026-11-01. It does not promise rankings, rich results or AI citations.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repository's SEO and GEO readiness, fix the highest-priority issues in code, and verify the fixes with the bundled checks.
Make this site's key pages easier to cite in AI answers without inventing facts, sources or statistics.
Add SEO and GEO regression gates to this project's CI.
